name: console-terminal help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:console-terminal. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Close tab
entries.text: Closes this terminal tab (Ctrl+Shift+W). If something's still running it asks first.

entries.title: New tab
entries.text: Opens a new terminal tab on the default connection.

entries.title: New tab menu
entries.text: Pick what the new tab opens: a shell or Claude Code, on which connection.

entries.title: Close window
entries.text: Closes the whole terminal window and its tabs.

entries.title: Claude Code
entries.text: Opens Claude Code in a tab.

entries.title: This tab's connection
entries.text: Where this tab runs: the console container, the VPS, a container or axHub.

entries.title: Find
entries.text: Searches the terminal's output (Ctrl+Shift+F).

entries.title: Text size
entries.text: Makes the terminal text smaller or bigger.

entries.title: Mouse mode
entries.text: On: a click moves the cursor to where you tapped. Handy on a phone.

entries.title: Copy
entries.text: Copies the selected text (Ctrl+Shift+C).

entries.title: Paste
entries.text: Pastes into the terminal (Ctrl+Shift+V). Several lines ask first.

entries.title: Terminal settings
entries.text: Fonts, colours, cursor, bell, scrollback and the Claude Code profiles.

entries.title: Hide this toolbar
entries.text: Hides the command toolbar. Right-click a tab to bring it back.

entries.title: Claude Code on…
entries.text: Opens Claude Code on the connection you pick.

entries.title: Shell on…
entries.text: Opens a shell on the connection you pick.

entries.title: Open a root shell anyway
entries.text: Opens a root shell on the VPS. Careful, kid: root can break anything.

entries.title: Paste
entries.text: Shows “Paste”. Part of Terminal.

entries.title: Start again
entries.text: Restarts what was running in this tab.

entries.title: Shell
entries.text: Opens a plain shell.

entries.title: Reconnect
entries.text: Connects this tab again after it dropped.

entries.title: Switch connection
entries.text: Moves this tab to another connection.

entries.title: New tab elsewhere
entries.text: Opens a tab on another connection.

entries.title: Colour scheme
entries.text: The terminal's colours.

entries.title: Font
entries.text: The terminal font.

entries.title: Cursor
entries.text: The cursor shape.

entries.title: Line height
entries.text: Space between lines.

entries.title: Padding
entries.text: Room round the text.

entries.title: Windows look
entries.text: Makes the terminal look like Windows Terminal.

entries.title: Mica background
entries.text: The see-through Windows background.

entries.title: Command toolbar
entries.text: Shows the row of command buttons above the terminal.

entries.title: Blinking cursor
entries.text: Makes the cursor blink.

entries.title: New terminal opens
entries.text: What a new terminal starts with.

entries.title: The + button
entries.text: What the + on the tab strip opens.

entries.title: Tab width
entries.text: How wide the tabs are.

entries.title: Bell
entries.text: What happens when a program rings the bell.

entries.title: Scrollback
entries.text: How many lines you can scroll back.

entries.title: Ask before closing
entries.text: Asks before closing a tab that's still running something.

entries.title: Copy on select
entries.text: Selecting text copies it straight away.

entries.title: Ask before pasting lines
entries.text: Asks before pasting more than one line, so nothing runs by accident.

entries.title: Mouse mode for new tabs
entries.text: New tabs start with mouse mode on.

entries.title: Mosh mode for new tabs
entries.text: New tabs start in Mosh mode (the phone-friendly connection).

entries.title: Permissions
entries.text: What Claude Code may do without asking in this profile.

entries.title: Tab colour
entries.text: The colour of this profile's tabs.

entries.title: Folder
entries.text: Which folder Claude Code starts in.

entries.title: Extra flags
entries.text: More Claude Code command-line flags, one per line.

entries.title: First prompt
entries.text: The message Claude Code starts with.

entries.title: Add a profile
entries.text: Makes a new Claude Code profile: model, permissions, folder, first prompt, colour.

entries.title: Open a terminal
entries.text: Opens the terminal window.

entries.title: Make a new key
entries.text: Makes a new SSH key for a connection.

entries.title: Slow
entries.text: The context chain types each rule out slowly, so you can read along as the agent picks it up.

entries.title: Normal
entries.text: The context chain's default pace: a little slower than reading speed.

entries.title: Fast
entries.text: The context chain reveals rules quickly; still one at a time.

entries.title: All
entries.text: Shows the whole context chain at once, no typing out.

entries.title: Skip to the end
entries.text: Stops the slow reveal and shows every file and rule the session has taken in so far.

entries.title: Pause
entries.text: Pauses the context chain's reveal where it is. Play carries on.

entries.title: Play
entries.text: Carries on revealing the context chain.

entries.title: Kill session
entries.text: Ends this tab's tmux session for good: whatever runs in it stops, on every device attached to it. Closing the tab only detaches.

entries.title: Kill session…
entries.text: Asks first, then ends this tab's tmux session for good. Closing the tab only detaches, like closing Moshi.

entries.title: Open in Moshi
entries.text: Copies the command that attaches this same session from the Moshi app (mosh to the VPS, then tmux attach). Both stay live at once.

entries.title: Side by side
entries.text: Shows the session and its context chain next to each other. Remembered for this tab.

entries.title: Stacked
entries.text: Shows the context chain under the session. Remembered for this tab.

entries.title: No split
entries.text: Hides the context chain; the tab shows only the session.

entries.title: Session
entries.text: On a phone the two panes swipe: this jumps to the live session.

entries.title: Context chain
entries.text: Every file the session reads, in the order it reads them (CLAUDE.md, its imports, rules, then each Read), with the rules it picks up typed out one at a time.

entries.title: Tabs live in tmux sessions
entries.text: VPS and console tabs run inside tmux on the server, so a reload, a sleeping phone or a console restart re-attaches with the scrollback replayed. Moshi can attach the same session.

entries.title: Context chain in headless tabs
entries.text: Headless build tabs split into the live session and its context chain.

entries.title: Split for new headless tabs
entries.text: How new headless tabs split: side by side, stacked or not at all. Each tab can change it in its menu.

entries.title: Context chain speed
entries.text: How fast the context chain types out the rules a session picks up. Slow is slower than real time on purpose.

entries.title: Sessions list
entries.text: Opens or closes the sessions list: My sessions (your own Claude Code and shell sessions, and your claude.ai chats), Agents (headless builds with their model, cost and status), Connections and Recent. On a phone it slides in from the left; swipe it back to close.

entries.title: Jump in
entries.text: Turns this read-only mirror into a live link on the same session, so what you type reaches it. On a claude.ai chat it opens the chat in claude.ai and keeps its feed here.

entries.title: Session browser
entries.text: Opens the Sessions page (Session check-in): every Claude session that has ended, with its model and cost.

entries.title: Stop session
entries.text: Ends this tmux session for good, for every device attached to it, Moshi included. Detaching a tab does not do this.

entries.title: Terminal sessions
entries.text: Opens the Terminal's sessions rail: your sessions, agents, connections and recent ones, to mirror or jump into.

entries.title: Context chain text size (share of the theme’s text)
entries.text: Slide to set “Context chain text size (share of the theme’s text)”: left is less, right is more. Part of Terminal.

entries.title: When a new session starts
entries.text: What the Terminal does when a headless Claude session starts. Add tab quietly (default) adds its tab in the background of an open Terminal window and shows a count on the Terminal toolbar icon, without bringing the window up. Do nothing adds no tab (the sessions list still shows it). Bring Terminal to front opens it and brings the window up.
